fieldValues.title: A PR stacked on another goes DIRTY when its base is squash-merged
fieldValues.summary: srs-web#650 (#641) was stacked on #647 (#639). When the owner squash-merged #647, GitHub re-targeted #650 to main and it went DIRTY: its first commits duplicated the squashed ones. The driver rebased with --onto the merged head, resolving a conflict with #591 that had landed meanwhile.
fieldValues.body:
- Stacking is the only way to build a chain's later items before review, and squash merges always break it.
- Suggested change: the holon delivery walk names stacked items and the rebase-onto step after each base merges.
